description: This file is a shell script used for testing git rev-list functionalities, including ancestor checks, limiting by parent number, and merge handling.

methods.name: check_revlist
methods.description: A helper function that runs 'git rev-list' with specified arguments and compares the output to expected results.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a given description.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the specified output is empty.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with a specified message or identifier.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the Git commit timestamp for simulation.

methods.name: test_tick_keep
methods.description: Stores the current test_tick value for repeated use.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
